system.roleplaying: You keep your positive outlook even when all hope is lost. Your spirit is nearly impossible to break.

greenAbility.name: Principle of Levity
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a dire situation where your jokes prevent demoralization and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
